name: @bogts/gateway
description: Bogts: the Cloudflare Worker (API, provider webhooks, dashboard)

scripts.deploy: vite build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

DB.description: D1 database for projects, payments, card tokens (encrypted) and the event outbox. Created for you.

BONUM_ENVIRONMENT.description: `production` or `test` (Bonum sandbox). Defaults to `production` when empty.

BONUM_APP_SECRET.description: Bonum merchant **App secret** from the Bonum merchant portal. Leave empty to switch Bonum off.

BONUM_TERMINAL_ID.description: Bonum **Terminal ID**. Leave empty to switch Bonum off.

BONUM_CHECKSUM_KEY.description: Bonum **webhook checksum key** (verifies `x-checksum-v2`). Leave empty to switch Bonum off.

QPAY_ENVIRONMENT.description: `production` or `test` (QPay merchant sandbox). Defaults to `production` when empty.

QPAY_CLIENT_ID.description: QPay merchant **client id**. Leave empty to switch QPay off.

QPAY_CLIENT_PASSWORD.description: QPay merchant **client password**. Leave empty to switch QPay off.

QPAY_INVOICE_CODE.description: QPay **invoice code** (invoice template) issued by QPay. Leave empty to switch QPay off.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: **Required.** 32 random bytes, base64. Encrypts card tokens, provider tokens and webhook secrets. Generate with `openssl rand -base64 32`. Never change it after the first payment.

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Password for the `/admin` dashboard, at least 12 characters. Ignored when Cloudflare Access is configured below. Without either, the gateway refuses to serve.

PUBLIC_ORIGIN.description: The public `https://` origin this Worker answers on, e.g. `https://payments.example.com`. Providers call back here; required for any provider to be on.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Optional. Your [Cloudflare Access](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/) team domain, e.g. `yourteam.cloudflareaccess.com`. Set together with `CF_ACCESS_AUD` to protect `/admin` with Access instead of a password.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: Optional. The Access application's **AUD tag**. Set together with `CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN`.
